headline: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts Donates $600K for AC at Northeast High School
meta_description: Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has donated $600,000 to install air conditioning at Northeast High School, bringing climate control to part of the…
summary_short: Philadelphia Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is bringing cool relief to Northeast High School with a $600,000 donation for air conditioning upgrades.
body:
Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts has donated $600,000 to bring air conditioning to a portion of Northeast High School. The significant gift addresses a long-standing need at the school, improving conditions for students and staff in spaces that previously lacked climate control.

Hurts' contribution represents a direct investment in his community's education infrastructure. By funding the HVAC upgrades, the quarterback is helping create a more comfortable learning environment during hot months—a basic amenity that many schools struggle to provide.

Funds will install air conditioning in part of campus
Philadelphia Eagles quarterback supports local education
